candidates.requirement: Exercise number parsing across two calls on the same tokener so the parser restores exponent state from the saved first chunk.
candidates.target_route: Create a tokener, parse `1e` with length 2, then parse `-2 ` with length 3 on that same tokener.
candidates.failure_condition: The entry makes only one parse call per newly created tokener, so the changed saved-number guard cannot be true in a subsequent call.
candidates.alternative_paths: Other numbers in the single call enter number state after its buffer is reset; a completed number changes state, while an unfinished chunk returns to the caller. No second call occurs.
